[/size]1. Download [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
﻿3. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)
4. Download this mod and unzip in your mods folder
5. First run the game using SMAPI to create the config.json file
6. Configure the mod however you like in the Mod Config Menu in the lower left corner of the home screen.

If you chose not to use the Generic Mod Config Menu, you need to close the game and open the Config.json file to make the settings, and once you finished you can open the game again.


﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/ORQQxZd.png[/img]﻿

This mod was initially created so that all the tools have the colors matching the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7742]Animal Crossing New Horizons Elephant Watering Can[/url] mod, so the idea is that these mods are used together, but for those who prefer to use only my mod it also has watering cans. To use both mods together, please set all watering cans to False.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/fEhTgKb.png[/img]﻿
